facebook.content:
Beloved, the Lord has placed you exactly where you need to be—no accident, no coincidence. Psalm 139:14 reminds us, “You are fearfully and wonderfully made.” Walk today in that truth; let every step be a testimony that God’s purpose is alive in you. I declare that the Spirit will empower you to fulfill the calling He gave you this morning.  

What has God already shown you about His purpose for your life?

instagram.content:
The Lord says, “Be still, and know that I am God” (Ps 46:10).  
When the world presses, I’m calling you to stand in His quiet. Let His peace settle your heart; let His power move your steps.  
Declare today: I walk in the strength of the Almighty.  

What has God’s presence revealed to you this week?
